prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1018; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just keep it to the facts, but sure. [Claimant name withheld] for the file.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened in the parking lot?

A: I was pulling out of a space near the store entrance, going slow, maybe five miles an hour. A white pickup came down the aisle fast and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car. I tapped the brakes, but there was no time to do more than that.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?

A: Not really. I heard the engine revving, and then it was on me. I didn't have a clear line of sight because a van was parked on the right side.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes. The airbag did not deploy, but the belt held me.

Q: Did you hit anything with your hands or arms during the collision?

A: I grabbed the steering wheel hard and twisted my left wrist against the door frame when I was thrown sideways. That's when the pain started.

Q: Have you received medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to urgent care that evening and they took X-rays. They said the wrist was fractured and put me in a cast. I'm seeing an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any other injuries?

A: Some neck stiffness and soreness in my shoulder, but the wrist is the main problem. I can't grip things well and I'm off work for now.

Q: Did you give a statement to anyone at the scene?

A: I spoke briefly with the other driver and gave my information to a store employee who came out to look.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was not speeding and I did everything I could to avoid the collision. I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing once we've reviewed the records.
